grade.summary: The proof is complete and correct. Lexicographic descent of the board product and the number of entries greater than 1 proves termination. Primewise, the gcd of all p-adic valuations is invariant under the Euclidean transformation (a,b)→(min(a,b),|a−b|). At a terminal board these invariants determine the unique remaining nonunit, and a prime appearing initially gives a positive invariant, ruling out a terminal board consisting entirely of 1s.
strengths: Uses a valid well-founded lexicographic monovariant for termination.
Correctly identifies and proves the primewise valuation-gcd invariant.
Correctly rules out zero remaining entries greater than 1.
Derives an explicit terminal value depending only on the initial board.
